sv.title: Frida Karlssons stalker ska genomgå sinnesundersökning
sv.summary: Frida Karlssons stalker ska genomgå en liten sinnesundersökning. Det stod klart efter ondagens förhandlingar i Eskilstuna tingsrätt där Frida Karlsson vittnade. – Jag har en högre grundstress, känner hela tiden ett obehag, sa hon.

en.title: Frida Karlsson's stalker to undergo mental examination
en.summary: Frida Karlsson's stalker is to undergo a brief mental examination. This became clear after Tuesday's hearings at the Eskilstuna district court, where Frida Karlsson testified. – I have a higher baseline stress, I constantly feel discomfort, she said.
